caption:
Wondering why life keeps testing you?

Allah asks this question in the Qur'an. Read it slowly and think about the test you are facing right now.

Surah Al-Ankaboot 29:2

Which test are you asking Allah to help you through?

#tests #trialsinlife #surahankabut #quranreels

Recitation: Maher Al-Muaiqly
alt_text: Do people think once they say, “We believe,” that they will be left without being put to the test (Surah Al-Ankaboot 29:2)
